Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryTypeS:
The types of POKéMON match up differently with each other.
Every type is stronger than some types and weaker than others.
Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NuggetUsel: A NUGGET is totally useless. So I sold it for ¥5000.
Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HeardGhost: I heard that ghosts haunt LAVENDER TOWN.
Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GiveEverst:
Oh… {PLAYER}! I've been looking for you!
It's me, one of the ever-present AIDES to PROF. OAK.
If your POKéDEX has complete data on twenty species, I'm supposed to give you a reward from PROF. OAK.
He entrusted me with this EVERSTONE.
So, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.
Have you gathered data on at least twenty kinds of POKéMON?
Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatHereY:
Great! You have caught or owned {STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!
Congratulations! Here you go!
Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReceivedEv: {PLAYER} received the EVERSTONE from the AIDE.
Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ExplainEve:
Making POKéMON evolve certainly can add to the POKéDEX.
However, at times, you may not want a certain POKéMON to evolve.
In that case, give the EVERSTONE to that POKéMON.
It will prevent evolution according to the PROFESSOR.
